content.en:
This report summarizes **31 papers** related to Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) that appeared on arXiv during the week of March 9–17, 2026. These include newly submitted papers and updated versions of earlier works. The papers span a wide range of topics including **LLM training infrastructure** (NVIDIA Megatron Core), **MoE compression and efficiency** (LightMoE, REAP, SliceMoE), **robotics and VLA** (MoE-ACT, LAR-MoE, MoDE-VLA, SAMoE-VLA), **computer vision** (M2IR, SPMTrack, UniMMAD), **time series forecasting** (MoHETS, Seg-MoE), **scaling laws** (Optimal Expert-Attention Allocation, qs Inequality), and **theoretical foundations** (Variational Routing, Optimal Transport Aggregation).

Institutions represented include **NVIDIA**, **KAIST**, **Tsinghua University**, **Peking University**, **HKUST**, **Imperial College London**, **Weizmann Institute**, **AMD Research**, **Cerebras Systems**, and many more from across 10+ countries.
content.zh:
本报告汇总了 2026 年 3 月 9 日至 17 日期间在 arXiv 上出现的 **31 篇** MoE（Mixture-of-Experts，混合专家）相关论文，包括新提交论文和早期工作的更新版本。

这些论文涵盖多个研究方向：**LLM 训练基础设施**（NVIDIA Megatron Core）、**MoE 压缩与效率优化**（LightMoE、REAP、SliceMoE）、**机器人与 VLA**（MoE-ACT、LAR-MoE、MoDE-VLA、SAMoE-VLA）、**计算机视觉**（M2IR、SPMTrack、UniMMAD）、**时间序列预测**（MoHETS、Seg-MoE）、**Scaling Law**（Optimal Expert-Attention Allocation、qs Inequality）以及**理论基础**（Variational Routing、Optimal Transport）。

涉及的机构包括 **NVIDIA**、**KAIST**、**清华大学**、**北京大学**、**香港科技大学**、**帝国理工学院**、**Weizmann Institute**、**AMD Research**、**Cerebras Systems** 等，来自全球 10 多个国家。

title.en: NVIDIA Megatron Core MoE Training Report
title.zh: NVIDIA Megatron Core MoE 训练报告

description.en: NVIDIA published an 88-page technical report on scaling MoE training with Megatron Core, achieving 1,233 TFLOPS/GPU on GB300 for DeepSeek-V3-685B. This is a production-ready, open-source framework used across academia and industry for training trillion-parameter MoE models.
description.zh: NVIDIA 发布了一份 88 页的技术报告，介绍 Megatron Core 的 MoE 训练优化。在 GB300 上训练 DeepSeek-V3-685B 达到 1,233 TFLOPS/GPU。这是一个已在学术界和工业界广泛使用的开源框架，支持万亿参数级 MoE 模型训练。

title.en: AMD's qs Inequality: MoE Inference Double Penalty
title.zh: AMD 提出 qs 不等式：MoE 推理的双重惩罚

description.en: AMD Research formalized the 'double penalty' of MoE at inference—routing fragmentation reduces weight reuse while massive expert pools reduce KV cache headroom. For DeepSeek-V3 at 128k context, a quality-matched dense model achieves 4.5x throughput advantage.
description.zh: AMD Research 将 MoE 推理的「双重惩罚」形式化：路由碎片化降低权重复用，同时大规模专家池挤压 KV Cache 空间。DeepSeek-V3 在 128k 上下文下，等质量的 Dense 模型吞吐量优势达 4.5 倍。

title.zh: 多篇论文被 ICLR 2026 录用

description.en: Several papers in this week's collection have been accepted to ICLR 2026: IMSE (KAIST), REAP the Experts (Cerebras/Calgary), One-Prompt Strikes Back (UT Austin et al.), Dynamic MoE for VAR (Amsterdam/Imperial), and Expert Selections privacy attack (MBZUAI/RAND).
description.zh: 本周收录的多篇论文已被 ICLR 2026 录用：IMSE（KAIST）、REAP the Experts（Cerebras/Calgary）、One-Prompt Strikes Back（UT Austin 等）、Dynamic MoE for VAR（Amsterdam/Imperial）以及 Expert Selections 隐私攻击（MBZUAI/RAND）。

title.zh: MoE 在机器人 VLA 领域持续爆发

description.en: Four papers this week apply MoE to robotic manipulation and autonomous driving VLA models: MoE-ACT (HKUST), LAR-MoE (TU Dresden), MoDE-VLA (SJTU/Shanghai AI Lab), and SAMoE-VLA (Tsinghua AIR). This indicates MoE is becoming a standard component in multi-task robotic policies.
description.zh: 本周有四篇论文将 MoE 应用于机器人操作和自动驾驶 VLA 模型：MoE-ACT（港科大）、LAR-MoE（TU Dresden）、MoDE-VLA（上交/上海 AI Lab）和 SAMoE-VLA（清华 AIR）。MoE 正成为多任务机器人策略的标配组件。

title.zh: Expert-Attention 计算分配的 Scaling Law

description.en: Researchers from HKUST and Ant Group derived an explicit formula for the optimal expert-attention compute ratio in MoE models, extending the Chinchilla scaling law to incorporate this new architectural parameter.
description.zh: 香港科技大学和蚂蚁集团的研究者推导出 MoE 模型中 Expert-Attention 计算比例的最优分配公式，将 Chinchilla Scaling Law 扩展到了这一新的架构参数维度。
